# Coordinated Production Direction

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs\production-bundles.md`, `docs\visual-development.md`
and the selected packet. Use for every new script/production and for workflow
feedback. Improve the reusable system before spending on isolated cosmetic fixes.

Use one validated packet, shot IDs and timeline. Fill the character's intention,
visible emotion, restraint and audio role for every beat. Cross-check all ten
department scripts exported by `film bundle`; do not independently invent their
durations, identities or scene boundaries. Sound direction starts before motion.

Real cast -> accepted scene frames -> coordinated design lock -> motion remains
mandatory. Plan light/shadow/effect interplay, causal transitions, hook, reaction
and hold where the lane needs them. Use the existing specialist skills; do not
launch a swarm merely because several departmental scripts exist.

Create `outputs\<topic>\vNNN\` bundles with scripts, actual frames, metadata,
temporary/source videos, audio, versioned delivery candidates and review records.
Use the claimed production owner, hash-verified sources and a new version.
Never delete/overwrite old work or imply a proposed script generated old media.

When feedback arrives, record what actually worked and failed. Preserve good
media, identify a missing rule/check/artifact, implement that workflow repair,
then require the appropriate actual review. Prompt/schema passes do not certify
listening, emotion, motion quality, final user consent or publication.
